verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Simanyi binabaawo,
Katonda abinkweka
Ennaku ze ndiraba-edda
Ankweka lwa kisa;
N'essanyu ly'atusuubiza
Lye lituwoomera

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ng'enda gy'antwala yonna
Mwesiga bwesizi!
Sibuusabuusa so sitya;
Kubanga ye amanyi.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Obutamanya obwo
Bwe nsinga okwagala;
Ankute n'omukono gwe
Yesu-annywezeza
Ampummuza buwummuza,
Kubanga mwesiga.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ng'enda gy'antwala yonna
Mwesiga bwesizi!
Sibuusabuusa so sitya;
Kubanga ye amanyi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Ka ntambule ne Yesu
Yonna gy'aba-antwala
Awali ye mu nzikiza
Nyinza okulaba
Era muzibe-amwesiga
Tayinza kubula.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Ng'enda gy'antwala yonna
Mwesiga bwesizi!
Sibuusabuusa so sitya;
Kubanga ye amanyi.
